# Lessons from fights

<!--
What went wrong in a fight and what to do instead, so the next similar fight (or the retry after a reload)
goes better. The bridge shows matching lines at a fight start ("LESSONS:") and when you enter a place
named in a trigger: keep triggers to words the game shows (enemy names or a name stem like "Justiciar",
races like "Undead", places) or: ambush, escort, ranged, surrounded, boss.
A lesson about the ground (a fall, a jump into a chasm) adds the trigger "fall": shown when you enter the
place, never at a fight start.
The memory keeper distills the session logs' [fight] debriefs and [lesson] notes into this file and merges
duplicates; the player may add a line too. Budget: <= 60 lessons, newest last. Every line:

- WHEN <trigger>, <trigger>: <what failed> → <what to do instead> (Sxxx) [seen]
-->
